evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth, 3.02→3.48 Torr (k=21→26), versus a stable ~3.0 Torr in purge/ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not an MFC setpoint/flow change
Temperature holds at setpoint 750 °C with normal heater power, so no thermal cause for the pressure rise
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress vs. exhaust restriction cannot be distinguished from telemetry

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: step Ar down and see whether pressure falls proportionally — blockage — or stays elevated — leak) to discriminate seal leak from exhaust blockage.
